nom: TULA Wrinkle Treatment Drops Retinol Alternative Serum

avis.texte: I feel a burning sensation after applying it. And it looks like this serum doesn't fully absorb into the skin.

I'm on my third bottle of this serum. it is the only serum that doesn't leave my skin with that dreaded "tight" feeling, but instead hydrates my skin and leaves a beautiful glow. I use it every morning after I cleanse. Works seamlessly under moisturizer and sunblock. I highly recommend for mature, dry skin if you'd like radiant skin results.
Ive been using this product for 2 years. I buy it every 3 months because it works!

First time using this. Cannot tolerate retinol so decided to give this a try. Some of the ingredients are suggested for people who are retinol sensitive. So far so good but it seems a bit greasy. No breakout issues so I will try applying a bit less.

avis.titre: I liked this until I didn't
avis.texte: I have used this for about a month now and at first really loved it! Only used it at night and felt it took a bit to soak in before I applied moisturizer but made my skin feel good and did notice some minimization of wrinkles. After 3 weeks of use, it started to burn my face when putting on (after no difference in application). First couple days it calmed down quick but then the last couple days it was to the point I had to wash it off. Going to have to look for something new. I would say if you are going to leave a review- use it for awhile & see if maybe the same thing happens to you.
Could not get the package pump to work. Don't have an opinion of the product at this time.
Super light but still feels like it's doing what it should! I hate thick serums that sit on top of the skin, and this one does NOT do that!!!
This serum is AMAZING!! Hydrates and gives my face such a glow without creating blemishes!!

avis.titre: So far seems to be helpin
avis.texte: So far seems to be helping my complexion look more even. I also use the brightening drops and dark spot serum. Love Tula, my skin is sensitive and like the natural alternatives to other products on the market!! I've been using their products for a couple of years now and I never get skin irritation but I still see results.
So bummed this product burns when I put it on my face. No thank you. I don't know the return policy but I wouldn't recommend this product.

avis.titre: Amazing! My skin loves this wrinkle serum!

This serum has become my favorite I love how soft and hydrated my skin feels after using it

I really wanted to like this product but sadly I will be retuning it. I tried this product for about two months and my skin hated it. Im not new to retinol and I wanted something more natural since I have sensitive acne prone skin. First application I looked like a got a very bad sunburn. I was only using this twice a week. After the first initial burn my cystic acne flared up and caused a purge which I was okay with at first. Ive never had this reaction with past retinols. My skin stays pretty clear for the most part. This made my skin look horrible and I realized it was a reaction to something in the ingredients over purging. I have other tula products that I love but this is not for me. I think for the price abd amout of product you get, there are better options out there.

I've been using TULA since 2016 and absolutely love everything in the anti-aging line — EXCEPT THE RETINOL ALTERNATIVE DROPS. The Retinol Alternative actively destroyed my skin. When I say destroy, I mean, to the point where my face is still recovering, with peeling dry crusty patches, two weeks after discontinuing use. I do NOT have sensitive skin. I know that new products can take time to work, and since I trust Tula, I tried to give this product a solid month of use. From day one, back in December: The drops dried out my skin completely and made me breakout like I was going through puberty again, only with wrinkles. It also gave me really odd raised bumps all around my eyes and cheeks - and that's the one place on my face where I have never in my life had any issues. My forehead wrinkles got so much deeper that I scheduled Botox for a month earlier than I usually do. Use: I used the drops every other day for a month for the first week, to get my skin conditioned to the treatment. The second week, I used them daily. I couldn't last any longer. Even my husband was like "Woah, babe, did you get into something that's irritating your skin?" Since I started using Clinique skincare in my teens, 25 years ago, (it was pretty much the only option back then!) I've never had this happen with any other product from any other company. I currently use Dermalogica, Tula, OSea and SkinScript. This is the kind of thing I would want to know about if I was working in product develop
